WITH base AS ( SELECT s.send_log_id, s.step_id, s.customer_id, s.status FROM send_log s WHERE s.kind = 'CAMPAIGN' AND s.status IN ('SENT', 'BOUNCED', 'FAILED') AND s.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND s.step_id IS NOT NULL
), flags AS ( SELECT b.step_id, b.customer_id, b.status, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_event e WHERE e.send_log_id = b.send_log_id AND e.event_type = 'OPEN' AND e.bot_yn = 'N') AS opened, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM track_event e WHERE e.send_log_id = b.send_log_id AND e.event_type = 'CLICK' AND e.bot_yn = 'N') AS clicked, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coupon_issue ci WHERE ci.send_log_id = b.send_log_id AND ci.used_at IS NOT NULL) AS coupon_used FROM base b ) SELECT step_id, count(*) AS attempted, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT') AS sent, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT' AND opened) AS unique_opens, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT' AND clicked) AS unique_clicks, count(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENT' AND coupon_used) AS coupon_used FROM flags GROUP BY step_id

SELECT CAST(d.day AS date) AS date, count(s.send_log_id) AS sent FROM generate_series(CAST(#{from} AS date), CAST(#{to} AS date), interval '1 day') AS d(day) LEFT JOIN send_log s ON s.kind = 'CAMPAIGN' AND s.status = 'SENT' AND s.sent_at >= d.day AND s.sent_at < d.day + interval '1 day' GROUP BY d.day ORDER BY d.day

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count = 0) AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SENDING') AS sending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count > 0) AS retrying FROM send_log WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING')
SELECT name FROM campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}
SELECT type FROM campaign WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId}

SELECT ws.step_id, ws.node_type, t.template_id, t.name AS template_name, CASE WHEN ws.config_json ->> 'couponId' ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN CAST(ws.config_json ->> 'couponId' AS bigint) END AS coupon_id FROM workflow_step ws -- AND 는 계산 순서가 보장되지 않아 CASE 로 감싼다 (숫자가 아니면 CAST 하지 않음) LEFT JOIN template t ON t.template_id = CASE WHEN ws.config_json ->> 'templateId' ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN CAST(ws.config_json ->> 'templateId' AS bigint) END WHERE ws.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND ws.node_type IN ('SEND_EMAIL', 'SEND_SMS') ORDER BY ws.step_id
